who_is_eligible: Small and marginal landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their name. Excludes institutional landholders, government employees, and income tax payees.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year provided as 100% Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into the beneficiary bank account.
required_documents: 1. Aadhaar Card; 2. Land Record (Khasra/Khatauni/RTC/Pahani); 3. Bank Account Passbook seeded with Aadhaar (NPCI active)
how_to_apply: 1. Visit official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in). 2. Click on 'New Farmer Registration'. 3. Enter Aadhaar number and mobile number, verify OTP. 4. Enter state, district, block, and land ownership details. 5. Submit for verification by local revenue authority.

who_is_eligible: Farmers possessing cultivable land with an assured water source (borewell/canal/well). Priority given to small and marginal farmers, SC/ST, and women farmers.
benefits: Up to 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers for installing drip and sprinkler micro-irrigation systems.
required_documents: 1. Aadhaar Card; 2. Land Ownership Record (7/12, RTC or Khasra); 3. Water Source / Electricity Connection Certificate; 4. Bank Passbook copy
how_to_apply: 1. Apply online via state horticulture/agriculture portal or national PMKSY portal. 2. Select pre-approved micro-irrigation manufacturer. 3. Upload land records and water availability proof. 4. Field verification by Assistant Director of Horticulture. 5. Subsidy credited via DBT.

who_is_eligible: All farmers, individual/joint borrowers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and SHGs/JLGs engaged in agriculture, dairy, or fisheries.
benefits: Revolving cash credit up to ₹3,00,000 at subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum (with 3% prompt repayment incentive). No collateral needed up to ₹1,60,000.
required_documents: 1. Completed KCC Application Form; 2. Aadhaar Card or Voter ID; 3. Land title deed/record of rights; 4. Passport size photographs; 5. No Dues Certificate from nearby banks
how_to_apply: 1. Visit nearest commercial bank, regional rural bank, or cooperative bank branch. 2. Fill out one-page simplified KCC application form. 3. Submit land records and identity documents. 4. Bank inspects crop plan and issues KCC RuPay card within 14 days.

who_is_eligible: Regular students studying in class IX to XII in government, government-aided, or local body schools who passed class VIII with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST).
benefits: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) from class IX to XII paid directly via DBT into student's bank account.
required_documents: 1. Aadhaar Card of student; 2. Class VII & VIII Marks Sheets; 3. Competent Authority Income Certificate (below ₹3.5 Lakh); 4. Student Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked); 5. School Bonafide Certificate
how_to_apply: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Submit application under Central Sector - NMMS. 3. Upload marks card and income certificate. 4. School Headmaster verifies details online. 5. District Nodal Officer approves for DBT disbursement.

who_is_eligible: Students belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), or Other Backward Classes (OBC) pursuing recognized post-matric or post-secondary degree/diploma courses.
benefits: Full tuition and non-refundable mandatory fee reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance ranging from ₹2,50,0 to ₹13,500 per year depending on course group.
required_documents: 1. Caste Certificate issued by Revenue Authority; 2. Family Income Certificate (below ₹2.5 Lakh); 3. College Admission/Fee Receipt & Bonafide; 4. Previous Qualifying Marks Sheet; 5. Aadhaar seeded Bank Passbook
how_to_apply: 1. Apply through state scholarship portal (e.g., SSP Karnataka, MahaDBT, NSP). 2. Create student login with Aadhaar. 3. Select current course, college code, and enter caste certificate RD/barcode number. 4. College verifies application electronically. 5. Direct credit to bank account.

scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
who_is_eligible: Meritorious students scoring above the 80th percentile in relevant stream in Class XII board examination and pursuing regular degree courses in recognized colleges/universities.
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for graduation (first 3 years) and ₹20,000 per annum for post-graduate studies.
required_documents: 1. Class XII Marks Card; 2. Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable); 3. Income Certificate (annual parental income <= ₹4.5 Lakh); 4. Aadhaar Card; 5. College Bonafide and Current Enrollment Certificate
how_to_apply: 1. Visit National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Apply under Department of Higher Education - CSSS. 3. Input Board Roll Number and Year of Passing. 4. College electronic verification followed by state nodal approval.

scheme_name: e-Shram Social Security & Accident Welfare Scheme
who_is_eligible: Unorganized sector workers, construction laborers, domestic maids, street vendors, agricultural laborers, and gig platform workers not covered under EPFO/ESIC.
benefits: Accidental death insurance of ₹2,00,000 and ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability under PMSBY. Seamless access to social security pensions and national welfare schemes.
required_documents: 1. Aadhaar Card; 2. Aadhaar-linked active mobile number; 3. Bank Account details (Account Number, IFSC code)
how_to_apply: 1. Visit eshram.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). 2. Enter Aadhaar number and verify OTP. 3. Enter residential address, educational qualification, and occupation details. 4. Download instant 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) e-Shram card.

who_is_eligible: Houseless families or families living in zero, one, or two-room houses with kutcha wall and kutcha roof as per SECC 2011 / Awas+ survey list.
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas for house construction, plus 90-95 person-days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA and ₹12,000 for toilet construction.
required_documents: 1. Aadhaar Card of all family members; 2. MGNREGA Job Card Number; 3. Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked); 4. Land ownership / possession document; 5. Gram Sabha resolution or Awas+ registration ID
how_to_apply: 1. Beneficiary list is prioritized by Gram Sabha based on SECC deprivation parameters. 2. Contact Gram Panchayat Secretary or Block Development Officer. 3. Geo-tagged photographs of existing house taken on AwaasApp. 4. Grant released in 3 milestone installments.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
who_is_eligible: Families categorized under rural and urban deprivation criteria as per SECC 2011, active RSBY holders, and expanded state welfare health lists.
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary healthcare hospitalization cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 27,000+ empaneled government and private hospitals nationwide.
required_documents: 1. Aadhaar Card or Ration Card; 2. Active Mobile Number; 3. PM-JAY Family ID / Ration Card containing family names
how_to_apply: 1. Check eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in or call toll-free helpline 14555. 2. Visit any empaneled hospital helpdesk (Ayushman Mitra) or Common Service Centre. 3. Carry Aadhaar and Ration Card for biometric e-KYC. 4. Receive instant PVC Ayushman Golden Card.

who_is_eligible: Women members of active Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) Self-Help Groups (SHGs) engaged in agriculture, livestock, or cottage enterprises.
benefits: Financial credit linkages from ₹1,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 at subsidized interest rates, specialized value-chain skill training, digital financial literacy, and market access assistance to earn >= ₹1,00,000 annual net income.
required_documents: 1. Aadhaar Card; 2. SHG Membership Record / Passbook; 3. Bank Account Passbook; 4. Micro-Enterprise Business Plan / Village Level Federation Recommendation
how_to_apply: 1. Coordinate with local SHG Village Organization (VO) and Community Resource Person (CRP). 2. Prepare micro-investment plan (MIP). 3. Submit plan to Gram Panchayat NRLM nodal coordinator. 4. Loan sanctioned through Community Investment Fund (CIF) or bank linkage.

who_is_eligible: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises and individuals starting or expanding manufacturing, processing, trading, or service enterprises.
benefits: Collateral-free business loans in 3 categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000), and Tarun (₹5,00,001 to ₹10,00,000) with Mudra Debit Card.
required_documents: 1. Proof of Identity (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID); 2. Proof of Residence; 3. Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased; 4. Business registration or trade license (if existing); 5. Bank statement for past 6 months
how_to_apply: 1. Apply online via Udyami Mitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank/NBFC. 2. Submit Mudra loan application form with proposed business idea. 3. Bank evaluates proposal without collateral. 4. Loan sanctioned and disbursed.

who_is_eligible: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools in 18 notified trades (carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, sculptor, cobbler, tailor, mason, etc.).
benefits: Recognition via PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card, skill upgradation with ₹500/day stipend during training, ₹15,000 modern toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit up to ₹3,00,000 in two tranches at concessional 5% interest rate.
required_documents: 1. Aadhaar Card; 2. Active Mobile Number; 3. Bank Account Passbook; 4. Ration Card / Family Details; 5. Declaration of traditional artisan trade practiced
how_to_apply: 1. Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and mobile phone. 2. Complete biometric authentication and trade registration. 3. Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body verification. 4. Screening Committee approval and certificate issuance.

who_is_eligible: Adult woman belonging to poor/deprived households (SC, ST, PMAY beneficiaries, Antyodaya, Most Backward Classes, or verified BPL list) having no existing LPG connection in the household.
benefits: Free LPG connection with security deposit waived for cylinder and pressure regulator, complimentary first refill cylinder and two-burner stove, plus targeted DBT subsidy of ₹300 per refill up to 12 refills/year.
required_documents: 1. Aadhaar Card of applicant (adult woman); 2. Ration card proving family composition; 3. Aadhaar of adult family members listed in ration card; 4. Bank account passbook with IFSC code; 5. 14-point declaration form
how_to_apply: 1. Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or visit local LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas). 2. Submit application form with ration card and Aadhaar copies. 3. Oil Marketing Company verifies deduplication to ensure single connection per kitchen. 4. Connection released.

who_is_eligible: All Indian citizens aged between 18 and 40 years holding a savings bank or post office account. Must not be income tax payees.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 starting from the age of 60 years until death, followed by lifetime pension to spouse, and return of full corpus to nominee.
required_documents: 1. Aadhaar Card; 2. Active Savings Bank Account or Post Office Savings Account; 3. Mobile Number for transaction alerts
how_to_apply: 1. Visit the bank or post office branch where savings account is maintained or log into internet banking. 2. Fill out APY enrollment form choosing desired pension amount (₹1k-₹5k). 3. Enable auto-debit authorization for monthly/quarterly contribution.

who_is_eligible: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child from her birth up to the age of 10 years (maximum 2 girl children per family).
benefits: High tax-free interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a.), exempt under 80C income tax deduction, triple tax exemption (EEE), partial withdrawal up to 50% for higher education at age 18, and full maturity after 21 years.
required_documents: 1. Birth Certificate of the girl child; 2. Identity Proof (Aadhaar/PAN) of parent/guardian; 3. Address Proof of parent/guardian; 4. Passport size photograph
how_to_apply: 1. Visit any authorized Post Office or commercial public/private sector bank branch. 2. Fill SSY account opening form. 3. Deposit initial minimum amount (₹250). 4. Passbook issued with girl child and guardian details.

who_is_eligible: SC, ST, and/or Women entrepreneurs setting up a greenfield (new) enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or the trading sector.
benefits: Bank composite loan (term loan and working capital) between ₹10,00,000 and ₹1,00,00,000 repayable in up to 7 years with a moratorium period up to 18 months.
required_documents: 1. Identity and Address Proof (Aadhaar, PAN); 2. Caste Certificate (for SC/ST); 3. Detailed Project Report (DPR); 4. Proof of greenfield manufacturing/service setup; 5. Bank Account statements
how_to_apply: 1. Register on Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in). 2. Complete registration and select whether handholding support is needed. 3. Apply to chosen scheduled commercial bank branch. 4. Bank reviews DPR and sanctions credit.

who_is_eligible: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for the first living child (and additional incentive for girl child in second pregnancy), excluding regular government employees.
benefits: Direct cash transfer incentive of ₹5,000 in two installments (or ₹6,000 for second girl child) to compensate for wage loss and promote nutritional maternal care.
required_documents: 1. Mother-Child Protection (MCP) Card; 2. Aadhaar Card of the mother; 3. Aadhaar Card of the husband; 4. Bank Account Passbook of the pregnant woman (Aadhaar seeded)
how_to_apply: 1. Register pregnancy at nearest Anganwadi Centre or approved government health facility. 2. Submit MCP card copy and Aadhaar within 570 days of Last Menstrual Period (LMP). 3. Anganwadi worker uploads details on PMMVY portal (pmmvy.nic.in). 4. DBT credited directly.

who_is_eligible: Students with Karnataka domicile belonging to SC, ST, OBC, EWS, or Minority communities pursuing post-matric courses (PUC, Diploma, ITI, Degree, PG, Engineering, Medical) in Karnataka.
benefits: 100% tuition and laboratory fee waiver/reimbursement directly credited to institution plus monthly maintenance stipend of ₹1,200 to ₹2,500 credited to student account.
required_documents: 1. Student Aadhaar Number; 2. Caste & Income Certificate RD Number (e-Pramana); 3. SSLC Registration Number; 4. College Registration Number / USN; 5. Disability Certificate (if applicable); 6. Aadhaar-seeded DBT Bank Account
how_to_apply: 1. Visit ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in. 2. Create student account with Aadhaar e-KYC. 3. Enter RD number of Caste and Income certificate (auto-fetched from revenue database). 4. Enter college admission details. 5. E-attestation officer verifies documents. 6. DBT sanctioned.
